ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels comprise approximately 65% of the visible distal surface area, while low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels are concentrated in the central region and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones are mapped to the outer 2/3 of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a central wedge radiating from the peduncle toward the trailing edge with irregular, feathered boundaries. Multiple discrete, dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) are mapped within the high-intensity white regions on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 22 degrees with a vertical depth of 12 pixels relative to the adjacent trailing edge peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; continuous sequence of peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary, with prominent jagged irregularities measuring 5-8 pixels in depth along the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curve along the trailing edge, transitioning into irregular, eroded geometries at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of five distinct high-contrast circular clusters: three located in the medial-distal white field of the left lobe and two in the distal white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark (approximately 40 pixels in length) is detected on the inner-mid section of the left lobe; two shorter diagonal linear marks are visible on the right lobe near the peduncle transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme structural irregularity and blunting at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant tissue loss or historical trauma.
